summary.text: Kristin Robbins is a Republican who represents District 37A in the Minnesota House of Representatives and was first elected in 2018.

Her official House page lists her committee assignments as including Fraud Prevention and State Agency Oversight Policy, Higher Education Finance and Policy, and Taxes, and gives her occupation as executive director, with a B.A. from Bethel University and an M.A. in economics from Washington University.

sources.title: Rep. Kristin Robbins (37A) - Minnesota House of Representatives
